title: Lambda rollout brief and fallback checkpad
content:
Summary:
This is a working brief for the Lambda (lightweight regional variant) rollout. Focus is on low-noise microtraffic shifts, deterministic fallback behavior, and compact release notes for downstream teams. Not final — using as the single source for preflight and immediate post-deploy actions for this lane.

Goals:
- Push Lambda model v2026-02-alpha behind a low-volume microcohort (0.5% global traffic) for 12h then step to 5%.
- Validate p95 latency, token-cost, and semantic quality against canonical prompt set.
- Ensure automated fallback to compatible quantized variant and to region-disabled route if GPU pool is degraded.

Rollout calendar (UTC):
- T-72h: Final smoke checklist review (owners: Ravi / Lina).
- T-24h: Nightly simulation run (traffic generator, internal staging).
- T-2h: Preflight smoke in canary region (console + tracing hooks enabled).
- T+0: Activate 0.5% traffic (12:00 UTC 2026-02-10).
- T+12h: Review telemetry; if green -> 2% for 6h.
- T+20h: If still green -> 5% for 24h, then standard ramp.
- Rollback window: first 36h are guarded; any step back is executed immediately on trigger.

Preflight checklist (quick):
- PRs merged and runtime image tagged (PR: runtime/pull/789).
- Canary infra artifacts: config pushed to config service, feature flag created (ff: lambda-rollout-2026-02).
- Observability hooks: traces, KV-cache telemetry, token accounting, and per-route cost tags flowing to console.
- Pager/rotation: on-call SRE present for first 8h of rollout.
- Customer comms: internal Slack-sig and affected-customer list prepared.

Launch checklist (day-of):
- Verify model checksum + hash in release artifact.
- Confirm autoscaler warmup targets for lambda pools.
- Enable KV prefix caching for canonical prompts.
- Set initial throttle: rate-limit to 50rps aggregated for lambda pool.
- Activate slow-path fallthrough: if latency > 1.2s for 30s -> route to quantized-lambda.

Telemetry signals to watch (primary):
- p95 latency per-region (threshold: 1.1s).
- 5xx error rate (threshold: 0.5%).
- Token-cost delta (unit-cost > +15% alarm).
- Quality regression score (eval harness median similarity drop > 3%).
- KV cache hit ratio (target >= 65%).

Fallback matrix (quick decision map):
- symptom: transient p95 spike in single region -> action: shift region traffic to sibling region, keep rollout percentage, page SRE.
- symptom: sustained p95 > 1.5s across regions -> action: revert to quantized-lambda variant, roll back to 0% if not recovered within 10m.
- symptom: quality regression on canonical prompts -> action: immediate step back to 0.1% and notify product and research, start fast-eval job.
- symptom: capacity depletion (GPU OOMs or long queue) -> action: enable emergency throttle and enable fallback tier (cpu-fallback route) + notify customers whose SLA is impacted.

Rollback ladder:
1) Gradual step back (5% -> 2% -> 0.5%) if degradation observed during staged ramp.
2) Full revert to previous model tag and disable feature flag.
3) Hotfix path: if revert not possible, instantiate protective throttles + divert to hosted-stable route and escalate to release lead.

Communication plan (internal + external):
- Internal: #release-orchestra thread becomes primary source; ping @oncall-sre and @product-owners on any threshold breach.
- External: Post short status notes to Customer Success for affected customers within 30 minutes of any rollback decision. Draft bullets for external note in "release_notes_draft" below.

Release notes (draft):
- Short: "Deploying Lambda model v2026-02-alpha — experimental regional variant designed to improve tail latency and cost for short-context workloads."",
- Details: "Initial rollout to a small cohort; default behavior will fallback to quantized-lambda on latency or cost regressions. If you experience degraded responses, please tag support with the header 'lambda-rollout-2026-02' and include the request ID."",
- Known limitations: "Not enabled for private deployments in this phase; limited language coverage for long-form generation (>2048 tokens)."

Post-deploy (first 48h):
- 1h, 6h, 12h, 24h checkpoints: telemetry snapshot + short annotated notes (owner: Samir).
- Run differential eval (canonical prompt set) at T+12h and T+24h.
- Cost reconciliation: compare token-level cost against baseline for the same cohort.

Quick commands & runbook links (ops cheats):
- rollout status: /internal/tools/rollout status lambda-rollout-2026-02
- revert: /internal/tools/rollout revert lambda-rollout-2026-02 --immediate
- enable fallback: /internal/tools/route set-mode lambda:quantized
- logs query: logsql "service:runtime AND route:lambda* AND timestamp:>now-1h"

Open questions / TODOs:
- Confirm whether private deploy customers need explicit opt-in for the next wave.
- Finalize canary traffic generator seed set (Ravi to provide list).
- Decide on z-score-based anomaly for cost alarm vs static threshold.

Notes to self:
- Keep the first 12h conservative; noisy metrics often normalize after autoscaler warm-up.
- If stepping back, keep detailed timeline in the release thread for postmortem.

Postmortem stub headings for follow-up:
- Timeline, Impact, Root cause hypothesis, What changed (code/config), Recovery actions, Follow-ups (owners + dates).

-- E.
